{{Top}}
'''Kway Teow''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the tropical [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that conflict, [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] maintained a secure compound just outside the city borders. Upon arrival on Felucia, Shu Mai landed at an executive landing platform in Kway Teow, from which it was a short speeder ride to her fortified compound.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Char kway teow|''Char kway teow'']] is a popular noodle dish in [[Wikipedia:Malaysia|Malaysia]] and [[Wikipedia:Singapore|Singapore]]; 'Kway Teow' literally means 'flat noodles'.
